dataset_name: Province of Ontario Neurodevelopmental Network (POND) Dataset
access_type: Restricted (Brain-CODE controlled data release; request via braincode.ca)
modality: MRI (MRS: T1w, T2w, DTI, resting and task fMRI), MEG
subject_no: 682 (controlled data release; >600 children and youth with matched imaging)

dataset_name: Baby Open Brains (BOBs) Repository
access_type: Open (Open via MIDB Open Data Initiative (AWS S3/Datalad))
institution: Masonic Institute for the Developing Brain (MIDB)
resolution: Isotropic 0.8 x 0.8 x 0.8 mm³ for both T1w and T2w scans
segmentation_mask: Yes (Manually curated, expert-reviewed infant brain segmentations)
preprocessing: Denoising and N4 bias field correction using Advanced Normalization Tools (ANTs)

dataset_name: NIH Pediatric MRI Data Repository (PedsMRI)
institution: Multiple institutions (National Institute of Child Health and Human Development (NICHD), National Institute on Drug Abuse (NIDA), National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH), National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke (NINDS))
preprocessing: Gradient nonlinearity correction (3D GradWarp), motion correction, EPI B0 distortion correction (DISCO), motion/eddy current/EPI distortion correction for DTI with b-matrix reorientation.

dataset_name: Longitudinal Brain Correlates of Multisensory Lexical Processing in Children
acquisition_protocol: T1 MPRAGE, DWI, and task-based fMRI.

dataset_name: A Low-Field MRI Dataset For Spatiotemporal Analysis of Developing Brain
institution: Children's Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine
resolution: In-plane: ~0.85 mm (0.82×0.82 mm² or 0.89×0.89 mm²). Slice thickness: 6-7 mm
slice_scan_no: Not specified (14 to 16 axial slices per subject)
acquisition_protocol: T2-weighted imaging on a 0.35T low-field MRI.
segmentation_mask: Yes (Manual brain masks and atlas-based segmentation using ANTs)
preprocessing: DICOM de-identified and converted to NIFTI and N4 bias field correction applied
clinical_data: Yes (Demographic information (gender, chronological age), radiologist's diagnosis of mild encephalopathy)
